Card Q&A.a: Yes. Blocking causes the attack target to be switched, so the effect activates.
Card Q&A.q: If I attack my opponent using a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards and my opponent blocks, does this card's inherited effect activate?
Does this card’s inherited effect activate when an attack target is switched for a Digimon other than a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards?

Inherited Effect: [All Turns][Once Per Turn] When an attack target is switched, this Digimon gets +1000 DP until the end of the turn.
